title: Overlapping Bimodal Cloud (Unidentifiable Components)
intuition: Two broad overlapping Gaussians at (-0.35, 0) and (+0.35, 0) (sigma=0.55) where component labels are not identifiable. Grades observable global mean, global covariance, and sliced W1 over a sustained terminal window.
failure_mode: Recipes that over-segment continuous overlapping clouds into rigid discrete blobs or oscillate across late updates miss the sustained covariance and sw1 gates.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 held transfer-vector task; deliberately omits unidentifiable per-component gates.
